title: The rocket equation
caption: Δv = u ln(m₀/m) grows only logarithmically with the mass ratio. Burning from 100 t to 25 t (ratio 4) gives Δv = 3000 ln 4 = 4160 m s⁻¹; doubling the ratio to 8 adds only another 2080 m s⁻¹.
alt: Graph of change in velocity against mass ratio, a logarithmic curve, with the point at ratio 4 and 4160 metres per second marked.
description: Δv = u ln(m₀/m): at ratio 2, 2080 m s⁻¹; at ratio 4, 4159 m s⁻¹; at ratio 8, 6240 m s⁻¹.
Each doubling of the mass ratio adds the same Δv, which is why rockets use stages.
